svg.aria-label: Always-on agent on Cloudflare: events reach a Worker, which hands them to one Durable Object per user. Inside it the inbox feeds runs; runs use memory, wait for approval on risky actions, set alarms that come back as new events, and send through the outbox. Runs can start a long Workflow. Traces and logs cover every step.
svg.text: Anthropic's five pieces (inbox, timers, memory, permissions, outbox) on Workers, Durable Objects and Workflows.
Assistant: one Durable Object per user
Think agent harness, everything saved in its own SQLite
Watching it: Cloudflare traces and logs on every request, run, tool call and alarm
PostHog adds traffic, session replays, one $ai_generation event per model call, and errors
